name: Butt Kick
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and arms bent loosely at your sides.
Jog lightly in place while snapping one heel quickly up toward your glute and swinging your opposite arm forward.
Land softly on the ball of your foot and immediately snap your opposite heel upward.
Continue alternating legs in a brisk, continuous rhythm for the target duration before easing down to a walk.
tips: Land lightly beneath your hips rather than stomping heavily onto your heels.
Keep your thighs pointing mostly downward instead of lifting your knees high forward.
